div.head: Leis Wl 39.1
div.ab: Ki tort eslevera u faus jugement fra pur curruz [u] pur hange u pur aveir, seit en la forfaiture le rei de XL solz, s'il ne pot aleier que plus dreit faire nel so[u]t; si perde sa franchise, si al rei nel pot reachater a soun plaisir.

He who promotes injustice or pronounces an unjust judgment, as the result of rage or malice or bribery, shall forfeit 40 shillings to the King, unless he can declare on oath that he did not know how to act more justly; he shall lose his right of jurisdiction, unless it be the King's pleasure to allow him to redeem it.
